items.headline: U.S. Markets Trade Mixed Amid Midterm Elections and Tech Earnings Swings
items.summary: U.S. equities saw mixed performance today, with the Nasdaq Composite showing gains driven by chip stocks, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average experienced a decline, largely weighed down by Apple's post-earnings slide. The S&P 500 edged higher in cautious trading as investors assessed key economic data and the ongoing midterm elections. Not financial advice.

items.headline: Apple Inc. Faces Headwinds on Margin Outlook
items.summary: Apple Inc. ($AAPL) shares fell 2.7% today after the tech giant issued a disappointing profit margin forecast, despite reporting stronger-than-expected profit and revenue for its latest quarter.

items.headline: Revvity Soars on Strong Earnings and Guidance
items.summary: Scientific software company Revvity ($RVTY) jumped 11.40% after surpassing Wall Street's third-quarter forecasts and raising its full-year guidance.

items.headline: Gartner Tumbles Despite Earnings Beat
items.summary: Gartner ($IT) tumbled 16.94% as investors focused on the underlying quality of growth, despite the research and advisory firm beating third-quarter earnings forecasts.

items.headline: Nvidia Leads Chip Stocks Higher
items.summary: Nvidia ($NVDA) rose 2.9%, contributing to a broader rally in chip stocks that supported the Nasdaq Composite today.

items.headline: Shopify Shares Decline on Weak Merchandise Volume Growth
items.summary: Shopify ($SHOP) nosedived 16.30% in early trading following reports of weaker-than-expected gross merchandise volume in its third quarter.

items.headline: Ibotta Surges on Revenue Beat
items.summary: Ibotta ($IBTA) led gainers with a 29.18% jump after its revenue for the latest quarter surpassed its own forecast.

items.headline: US Economy Exceeds Forecasts with 3.4% Q3 GDP Growth
items.summary: The U.S. economy expanded at an annual rate of 3.4% in the third quarter of 2026, surpassing expectations. This growth, up from 2.2% in the second quarter, was fueled by stronger business investment, consumer spending, and government outlays, while inflation showed signs of cooling.

items.headline: Fed Holds Rates Steady; December Hike Possible
items.summary: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) maintained interest rates on October 28th, despite persistently elevated inflation. However, remarks from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh suggest potential rate hikes starting as early as December.

items.headline: Job Openings Remain Stable in September
items.summary: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported today that the number of job openings remained largely unchanged at 7.5 million in September 2026. Hires and total separations also showed little change, though quits saw a slight increase.

items.headline: Pfizer Raises 2026 Guidance After Strong Q3 Results
items.summary: Pfizer ($PFE) reported third-quarter 2026 results that exceeded expectations, with strong revenue growth from recently launched and acquired products contributing significantly to its $16.6 billion total revenue for the quarter. The company subsequently raised its full-year guidance.

items.headline: Midterm Elections Influence Market Sentiment
items.summary: Today's U.S. midterm elections are contributing to market unsteadiness, with investors closely watching for results that could signal shifts in policy, particularly concerning the technology and AI sectors.
